newsitem.title: UK: IPE oil futures ease on warm U.S. weather.
newsitem.headline: IPE oil futures ease on warm U.S. weather.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures were weaker on Tuesday as U.S. heating oil futures sagged on news of unseasonably warmer weather in the U.S., traders said.
April Brent was 10 cents a barrel down on the day at 1601 GMT, trading at $20.24, while March NYMEX heating oil was 1.61 cents a gallon down at 59.20 cents.
Brokers GNI said in a daily report that poor fundamentals in the North Sea continue to act as a weight on IPE oil futures.
"The potential for a mild technical rally was scuppered by essentially soggy fundamentals in Europe.
Weekly energy statistics from the U.S., which usually appear after the market close on Tuesdays, are expected to be delayed for 24 hours due to Monday's President's day holiday.
